description: An invariant that calls a function declared `function`: E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE (only pure `fn` calls).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 7: a call of a function declared `function` … is E-DECL-INVARIANT-IMPURE; ruling S483 item 1: "Reads only the value's own fields, literals and pure `fn` calls".
